Risk: No authorized real recordings or joinable sales outcomes
Trigger: No approved data agreement by 23 October
Response: Use synthetic UX only; evaluate public ASR corpus separately; explicitly report inability to test sales feature gain.

Risk: Poor Kazakh Russian or mixed language accuracy
Trigger: Language target missed or key entity errors
Response: Run stratified pilot; expose correction; narrow supported scope; compare ASR alternatives.

Risk: ASR or summary invents an objection or amount
Response: Require segment evidence and human approval; preserve raw transcript revision; reject unsupported items.

Trigger: Features unavailable at decision time or client overlap across split
Response: Define prediction time; exclude duration for pre call model and post outcome text; split by customer and time.

Trigger: Unprotected object or secrets in proposed tracked files
Response: Private storage role tests anonymized exports content free logs and documented deletion.

Risk: GPU memory or inference latency exceeds budget
Response: Benchmark smaller quantized model; process jobs asynchronously; cap pilot size and report hardware.

Risk: Interviews supervisor review and real history missing
Response: Schedule real discussions and review; keep pending status; do not manufacture evidence or backdate history.

Risk: Existing product support or pricing changes
Response: Recheck official capability pages; use verified language lists; distinguish vendor description from tested behavior.

Risk: Scope expands into live coaching and automated staff assessment
Response: Record change request and capacity impact; prioritize mandatory CSV post call features first.
